note: Evidence-linked coverage map. Roles are research classifications, not findings of liability or universal legal-party status. A match in a generic search, an archive catalogue entry, an institutional page and a direct company record are different levels of coverage. Search pages are labelled as search/index routes, not as evidence that a matching entity record exists. A Wayback target is not a successful capture until a timestamp is returned by the live archive worker.
